subject: Hosted API commit increase & monthly tier bump?
messages:
From: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@starpay.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@starpay.com
Date: 2027-05-15T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API commit increase & monthly tier bump?

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from the ops team — we're seeing sustained growth in token consumption and expect monthly usage to trend ~3x our current committed level starting June. Attached is a short forecast (starpay-usage-forecast.xlsx) showing expected monthly peaks.

Can Redwood provide options for:
- Increasing our monthly committed tokens and re‑tiering to the next rate band
- Burst/buffer pocket to handle spikes while we transition
- Any recommended rollout (canary percentage, throttling guidance) so we don't get unexpected throttles in production

Budget-wise the execs have flexibility if there's a clear cost-per-token improvement vs pay-as-you-go. Also need to know how proration will be handled mid-term and whether we can preserve our latency SLO during the uplift.

Would love a short call this week to go over tangible options and a draft amendment.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Thompson
Head of Platform Engineering, StarPay
alex.thompson@starpay.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: starpay-usage-forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@starpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit increase & monthly tier bump?

Hi Alex — thanks for the forecast and the clear asks. Short answer: we have two pragmatic paths that fit your timeline. I attached a one-page proposal (redwood-uplift-proposal.pdf) with numbers; summary below.

Option A — Commit uplift (recommended)
- Increase to 3x current committed tokens/month (effective immediately upon amendment)
- New rate band reduces unit price by ~22% vs your current band
- Proration: we prorate the remainder of the current month at the new rate for committed tokens; any previously paid overages are credited against future invoices per the SOW
- Operationally: canary rollout at 10% of traffic for 72 hours, then 50% for 48 hours before full flip to avoid unexpected token surge effects

Option B — Temporary burst pocket + smaller commit
- Add a burst buffer equal to ~25% of projected peak to absorb spikes while you migrate
- Lower immediate commit (1.5x current) to reduce invoice impact

SLO & latency: both options maintain the same latency SLOs; if you want a tighter latency SLA we can map you to our dedicated capacity pool (adds incremental monthly fee).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preferred option
2) We circulate a short amendment (1–2 pages) for signature and decide proration effective date
3) Karthik and Marissa will handle the billing/invoice wording and ops handoff; me to coordinate rollout windows with your on-call

If you're available Friday (5/16) 10am PT I can do a 30m to get this over the line.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Direct: (408) 555-0234

Attachment: redwood-uplift-proposal.pdf (proposal, 12KB)

From: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@starpay.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: StarPay Finance <finance@starpay.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit increase & monthly tier bump?

Evelyn — thanks, Option A looks like the right long-term move. A few quick clarifications before we sign:
- Can you include a paragraph in the amendment confirming the canary percentages and rollback plan (we want this auditable for our change board)
- Confirm overage treatment if our traffic overshoots the committed tokens during month 1 (we prefer automatic throttle + overage invoice vs unexpected billing spikes)
- Any lead time required to enable a dedicated capacity pool if we decide to take tighter latency SLA later?

Finance is copied and will look at the proration math once you send a draft. If you can send a 1–2 page amendment and a DocuSign link we can aim to sign by EOD Friday.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — if you want to take the call now we can jump into details.

Alex

Subject: Fwd: StarPay acceptance — prod rollout and invoice wording

Folks — Alex verbally confirmed they want Option A (3x commit uplift). Finance is looped and asked for a quick amendment + DocuSign. Two asks for you both:

Karthik — can you draft a one-page amendment with:
- Effective date = first day of next billing cycle after signature (prorated as you normally do)
- Explicit canary percentages + rollback language (Alex asked for this to be auditable)
- Overage policy: automatic throttle + overage invoice at the new committed rate; include sample invoice line items
- If we include optional dedicated capacity SLA language, add an appendix describing lead times and incremental monthly fee

Marissa — please prepare the billing delta and a proration example for finance (include sample invoice amounts for month-of-signature). Also prep a HubSpot deal update and attach the amendment draft.

I'll draft the DocuSign envelope and coordinate an ops window for the canary flip — suggest 10% traffic for first 72 hours starting Saturday 5/22 02:00–05:00 PT, then 50% for 48 hours. Ops should monitor KV cache hit rates and tail latency.
